entry_state: The body closes with separate release obligations and a prospective implementation sequence. AppendixA now grounds the operation registry in three concrete exchange packages; next inspect the individual mutation, probability, query and work-control signatures against the earlier common envelope.
findings: 367: Review commit, time selection, compile, construct, refine and query preserve their distinct effects. A correction may replace constraints; witness examples do not define the whole history family. Probability evaluation does not select its result.

368: Probability admission and selection are separate transactions. Scenario projection remains conditional. Accounting assessment, authorization, proposal and atomic commit have separate signatures; assess-only evidence cannot authorize posting.

369–370: Reporting, explanation, resume, export, import and migration preserve prior meanings and ownership. Closed accounting records separate synthetic/real books and precommit references; method registration does not establish financial applicability.

371–372: OrderedEPS records bind context, finite inventory, weighted increments and potential/actual windows. Unsupported or unresolved series preserve independently ready basicEPS while withholding dilutedEPS; structural rejection returns neither. The scope remains the stated additive finite method. Reduced rational representation and result traces are consistent with the earlier worked examples.
Six rendered reference pages read in order. AppendixA continues; no new defect confirmed.
